instructions.base: I’m getting supplies to repeat this demo. I have one of these two types of cup in mind for a spare pack. Get a pack of the kind I mean; the brand and pack size can differ. Also get a spare handheld light. Match the kind of light I actually use to check these coloured samples, not its brand or casing.

clarification.canonical_answer: The little clear sample cups in front, the one-ounce size.

composite_events.request: I’d like a few colours to compare next time. Add one pack of ink highlighters with at least three different colours.

Someone else will run the next demo. Make the spare light USB-rechargeable, and get just one light, not a multipack. Choose one that only gives the kind of light I used, so they can’t switch to the wrong kind. Different brightness settings are fine. Keep the rest as is.
